finding.packet_premise: 00AA5840 and 00AA7E00 were described as two widget factories, and 00AAA710/00AAA480/00AA5A00/00AA6560 as the reader half of the descriptor table at 00AAAED0.
finding.actual: GUI pages are Lua source. 00AA5840 is the page factory; 00AA7E00 is a one-level named-child search, not a factory. 00AAA710 is both the property reader and the child builder. 00AA6560 is the type-id dispatcher. 00AA5A00 is a sorted child snapshot and 00AAA480 is the MSVC std::sort introsort loop, a library template instantiation with no GUI meaning.

file_format.kind: Lua source executed by the embedded interpreter
file_format.model_sidecar: '<page>.mmod' (00D0E67C) probed against the VFS singleton 0109CEEC; optional backdrop, not the layout
file_format.child_rule: a string key whose suffix after the last '_' names a type becomes a child widget; other string keys are properties; integer keys are skipped by the base reader

conventions.00AA5840: __thiscall(ECX = GUI manager, const NativeString *name, int screen_flag, char add_reference), RET 0Ch, body 00AA5840-00AA59A9
conventions.00AA7E00: __thiscall(ECX = widget, const NativeString *name, int unused), RET 8, body 00AA7E00-00AA7EAE; the second stack argument is popped but never read
conventions.00AA6560: __fastcall(ECX = type id, EDX = object or 0), RET
conventions.00AC5600: __thiscall(ECX = name string), returns the composed path

widget_types.note: page root; no key produces it
factory singleton 00F8BC10; 00A9DF40 when EDX is 0, 00AA5B40 otherwise

type_suffix_split.fallback: whole key when there is no underscore

visitor_vtable.+04h: descend into the sub-table named by the key variant
visitor_vtable.+0Ch: read one property: (name variant, field variant, default variant), each 8 bytes by value
visitor_vtable.+18h: fill a 500-entry key array, count returned in the frame

widget_vtable.+18h: the class property enumerator; reaches 00AAA710 for the base fields
widget_vtable.+34h: visibility setter called after Visible is read

registration.order: sorted insert before the first page with a strictly greater +FCh
registration.layers: none found; Priority is the only order

corrections.claim: 00AA7E00 takes a group and creates a child of it
corrections.correction: it finds an existing child by name; the names it lists are keys in the installed interface/_mouse.lua and interface/_highlight.lua
the argument is popped by RET 8 and never read; the search is one level deep

corrections.claim: 00AAA480 is part of the descriptor reader
corrections.correction: it is the MSVC std::sort introsort loop; it should not receive a BSP_Gui* name

installed_validation.cross_check: an independent Python reference and the committed C++ implementation produce identical counts
installed_validation.malformed_page: _debugtexts.lua has a stray comma and a statement-level ['Template_Text'] = {...}, which is not valid Lua

uncertainties: The second argument of 00AA5840 (1 from most screens, 0 from the loading screen) reaches screen +120h; nothing read here consumes it.
The .mmod branch is unexercised on this installation: no interface/*.mmod exists and the name carries no directory. Manager +30h was not followed.
00AC6600 was read, not reconstructed. Its pseudocode is corrupted (unaff_EBX/EBP); the Lua API it uses and its error path are unrecovered.
The variant tags are named from field widths and defaults, not from a tag table. Tags 1, 4 and 7 were not observed.
The key order the visitor's +18h yields is a Lua table's, which is undefined. The reconstruction keeps the script's textual order, which is a choice.
Six shipped keys spell 'visible' in lower case; Lua lookups are case-sensitive, so those are probably dead. Inferred from the language, not from the visitor.
00AA30C0, called first by 00AA52A0, was not read; 'retain' is a guess from position.
what_remains: The visitor class implementing vtable +4h/+8h/+0Ch/+18h and its value coercion.
The per-class property readers, where States, Texture, Font, Align, geOrder and FrameSizesX/Y are consumed.
The Listbox factory at 00F8BC10 and 00AA5B40's non-zero path.

followups.contract: The Lua reader behind vtable +4h/+8h/+0Ch/+18h: how a table key becomes a typed value, what the 500-entry key array is, and what an erroring script leaves behind.
The Icon class (id 6, 138h bytes): States, Texture, UV_LURB, ShaderName and how a state index selects a texture.
The Text class (id 3, 1F4h bytes): Font, Align, VerticalAlign, Multiline, DefaultText, DefaultShadow, and the tie to the font layout packet.
geOrder/RenderOrder: where the sorted child snapshot is consumed and how it reaches the draw queue.

build: scripts/build.ps1, Win32 MSVC /W4 /WX, clean; reconstructed_math passes with one added case for the 00AA2490 suffix boundary
